steps.name: claim-verifier-runtime-wiring
steps.summary: The daily generation path now runs normalized writer claims through the existing verifier with its verified post sources, blocking invalid factual claims before private persistence.

steps.name: hermes-no-tool-enforcement
steps.summary: Make the article-writing Hermes invocation unable to use web or other tools after research input has already been verified, while retaining the approved provider, model, OAuth, and included-cost gates.

steps.name: quality-gate-failure-reason-handoff
steps.summary: Carry redacted quality-gate failure categories and messages through the daily runner result instead of collapsing every blocked article into a generic generation_failed result.
